name: Chiaki
source: At first glance, he gives off an arrogant and unemotional impression; for some reason, however, he is inexplicably and strongly protective of those he lets in and opens his heart to.
translation: At first glance, he gives off an arrogant and unemotional impression; for some reason, however, he is inexplicably and strongly protective of those he lets in and opens his heart to.
